entities.name: Cross-Border Telehealth Platform
entities.description: Provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients across the EU and US while enforcing strict regional data residency and regulatory compliance.

entities.name: Patients
entities.description: End-users receiving video consultations, e-prescriptions, and using the AI symptom checker.

entities.name: Licensed Clinicians
entities.description: Healthcare professionals providing video consultations and issuing e-prescriptions to patients.

entities.name: Compliance Officers / Auditors
entities.description: Personnel responsible for auditing system logs and ensuring regulatory compliance.

entities.name: EU National E-Prescription Gateways
entities.description: External EU gateways for managing and transmitting e-prescriptions.

entities.name: US Pharmacy Networks (Surescripts)
entities.description: External US pharmacy networks for processing prescriptions.

entities.name: Identity Providers (eIDAS / OAuth2/OIDC)
entities.description: External identity providers for secure authentication and identity verification.

entities.name: Regional Payment & Insurance Gateways
entities.description: External gateways handling regional payments and insurance verification.

interfaces.description: Video consultations, e-prescriptions, and AI symptom checking
Conducting video consultations and managing patient care

interfaces.protocol: secure APIs via mTLS and HL7 FHIR / REST
secure APIs via mTLS and HL7 FHIR / REST
HTTPS/REST with tokenization via GCP VPC Service Controls

naming_conventions: External systems are named with specific regional or organizational identifiers (e.g., EU National E-Prescription Gateways)
Persons are named using descriptive user roles in plural form (e.g., Patients, Licensed Clinicians)
